caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug placed centrally within a square border on a plain, light background. The jug is round with a narrow neck and a small, flat-topped opening. It has a single curved handle attached from the top of the neck to the shoulder of the jug. The surface of the jug is predominantly brown with various shades of darker and lighter brown creating a mottled, glossy texture, and there are areas where dripping glaze is visible. The overall appearance of the jug is rustic, with some small, irregular spots and highlights. There is a faint, rectangular pencil border framing the jug, and in the lower right corner outside this border, the name "Annie B. Johnston" is written.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
